description: Two independent switches, each passing one of its two inputs to its own output under voltage control

params.text: Gate selects the A input while the CV input is low and the B input while it is high; trig flips from one input to the other on each rising edge and leaves it there

inputs.text: Reaches that channel's output while the switch is on A, which in gate mode is while the CV input is low
Reaches that channel's output while the switch is on B, which in gate mode is while the CV input is high
Chooses which of that channel's two inputs reaches its output, reading high at 1V and low again at 0.5V

outputs.text: Carries whichever of that channel's two inputs the switch has selected
